metadata.description: Reviewed pre-production PET radionuclide constants for the single-patient source model. Half-lives are source values; patient dose-rate constants are source-backed or explicitly derived and rounded as recorded per radionuclide.

dose_rate_provenance.source_title: AAPM Task Group 108: PET and PET/CT Shielding Requirements
dose_rate_provenance.source_organisation: American Association of Physicists in Medicine
dose_rate_provenance.source_value: 0.092 µSv·m²·MBq⁻¹·h⁻¹ patient dose-rate constant at 1 m
dose_rate_provenance.reference_id: AAPM Report No. 108; Medical Physics 33(1):4-15; DOI 10.1118/1.2135911
dose_rate_provenance.derivation: Directly adopted patient-source constant including the TG-108 patient self-attenuation convention.

half_life_provenance.source_title: MIRD Radionuclide Dosimetric Data Sheet: Gallium-68

dose_rate_provenance.source_title: AAPM TG-108 F-18 patient constant scaled by annihilation-photon yield
dose_rate_provenance.source_organisation: Derived from AAPM TG-108 and evaluated decay data
dose_rate_provenance.reference_id: AAPM Report No. 108; MIRDspecs Ga-68 and F-18 decay data
dose_rate_provenance.derivation: 0.092 × (Ga-68 positron yield / F-18 positron yield), rounded to 0.085. This is a model-derived patient constant, not a direct Ga-68 patient measurement.
